captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional holiday park. Not a client project.

Summer holidays are close, and a lot of caravan park sites still keep their rates in a PDF and their availability in a booking widget that is slow to load on a phone.

So we put a booking card under the hero photo: dates, guests, site type, one button. Cabins and tent sites sit right below with photos.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional holiday park’s homepage, rebuilt for summer bookings.

The old version has a great view, then a booking calendar that keeps spinning and the rates in a downloadable PDF. Families planning January are left pinching and zooming.

The new one puts a booking card under the photo: dates, guests, site type and one button. Cabins and tent sites sit just below with photos.

Not a client project. If your park’s site works like the old version, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
